name: agentic-knowledge-graph
description: Local development commands only. This is NOT a build manifest: each portal and service owns its own dependencies and is deployed independently.

scripts.local:contracts:test: uv run --directory Libraries/python/akg-contracts --with pydantic --with pytest python -m pytest -q
